mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_billing_policy (customer_id, policy_type, name, scope, params, priority, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{policyType}, #{name}, #{scope}, #{params}, #{priority}, #{isActive}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_billing_policy SET policy_type = #{policyType}, name = #{name}, scope = #{scope}, params = #{params}, priority = #{priority}, is_active = #{isActive}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM customer_billing_policy WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND policy_type = #{policyType}
